verifications.claim: As of April 2026, Mike Brown is the head coach of the New York Knicks.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Mike Brown is the Head Coach of the New York Knicks.' (dated 2026); R2: 'Knicks coach Mike Brown'; R6: context of 2025-26 season with 51 wins late in season.
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources confirm Brown as Knicks head coach during 2025-26 season, including into 2026.

verifications.claim: Mike Brown was named head coach of the New York Knicks on July 7, 2025.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'Jul 7, 2025... The New York Knicks hired Mike Brown on Monday'; R5: 'named the head coach... on Monday, July 7'; R1: 'On July 8, 2025, Brown became' (minor date variance).
verifications.reasoning: Primary sources (ESPN, USD) specify July 7 announcement; R1 says July 8 'became,' slight discrepancy but supports naming/hiring in that timeframe.

verifications.claim: Mike Brown was hired as head coach of the New York Knicks in July 2025 following the departure of Tom Thibodeau.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'hired Mike Brown... after firing Tom Thibodeau'; R6: 'fired Tom Thibodeau during the offseason' (context July 2025).
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly state hiring in July 2025 after Thibodeau's firing.

verifications.claim: Mike Brown tied a franchise record with 51 wins in his first season as head coach of the New York Knicks.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R6: 'With his 51st win, Brown tied former coach Pat Riley for having 51 wins in their first season with the team.'
verifications.reasoning: Directly states tying record for 51 wins in first season.

verifications.claim: In the 2025-26 season, Mike Brown tied Pat Riley (1991-92) for the most wins (51) by a Knicks head coach in their first season.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R6: 'Brown tied former coach Pat Riley for having 51 wins... Riley had a 51-31 record during the 1991-92 season'; '51 wins in the 2025-26 NBA season.'
verifications.reasoning: Exactly matches details including season, wins, and Riley comparison.
